verdict.rationale: Foreloop offers an embeddable feedback widget that lets end-users submit feedback without leaving the page and routes it into projects, but setting it up requires adding an npm package or a script tag and a widget key into the site's code, which typically still needs some engineering touch rather than a PM-only, no-code portal setup. missing for 10: evidence of a no-code/PM-only portal builder (e.g. hosted page, drag-and-drop setup) and confirmation that non-engineers can add the widget tag without developer involvement.
